screening.prompt: An unretouched editorial photograph of a ceramicist by a north-facing workshop window, holding a small celadon cup between both hands. Visible pores, ash on the apron, bounced daylight, sparse background.

A full-body documentary photograph of a bicycle courier kneeling to thread a chain through the rear derailleur at a curb. Show both shoes, one hand on the pedal and the other guiding the chain, rain-dark pavement, candid posture.

Two people at a crowded night market pass a paper-wrapped bundle over a low counter, with each person's hands visibly gripping opposite ends. A vendor's balance scale stands separately at the right, warm lights and realistic distances.

Photograph straight down a vaulted stone railway arcade, repeating columns and parallel floor joints converging toward a single vanishing point. The last arch opens onto a bright courtyard, no people, faithful construction geometry.

Macro product photograph of a scratched brass compass half-open on coarse indigo linen next to a fractured white shell. Distinguish the directional weave, shallow metal scratches and the shell's layered edge, subdued afternoon light.

A documentary photograph of a red kettle on the left end of a black workbench, a clear jar of screws directly behind the kettle, and a folded blue cloth on the far right. In a mirror above the bench the same objects appear in a consistent reflection.

confirmation.prompt: A candid photograph of an elderly watchmaker wearing magnifying glasses, face turned slightly toward a lamp, both hands holding the same small watch movement. Keep the skin and lenses realistic.
Full-length reportage image of a woman carrying a folded wooden chair up three steep steps, one foot planted on a step, both hands visibly supporting the chair, side lighting on a rainy day.

Two climbers at ground level exchange a rope coil, both people visible from boots to heads. The near person wears green and the far person wears orange, hands and rope clearly separated from the rocky background.
Wide interior photograph of an empty concrete staircase wrapping a rectangular light well. Continuous straight rails, parallel repeating landings, and physically consistent skylight shadows.
Photograph a rough jagged geode beside a fine nylon repair patch and a piece of smooth slate. Three materially distinct surfaces in the same shallow light, no oversharpening halos.

A low camera faces three separate glass containers on a pale kitchen counter. A green pear sits behind the left container, the middle container holds three dark plums, and the right container is empty. Preserve the ordering and transparent glass boundaries.

optional_identity.screening_prompt: {identity}, natural shoulder-up photograph on a windy station platform, side light and a dark wool coat.
optional_identity.confirmation_prompt: {identity}, candid seated indoor photograph in soft window light, neutral expression and light knit clothing.
